description:
You are an energy engineer retrofitting a 4-storey commercial office building. Occupants on the Top Floor (T.*) have reported thermal discomfort at the perimeter. Your task is to install a dedicated hydronic heating system for the top floor perimeter zones in the eQUEST model.

Specific Requirements:
1. Create a new Hot Water Loop named 'Perimeter_HW_Loop' (Type: Pipe, Subtype: Hot Water) with a Design Supply Temperature of 180°F.
2. Create a new Boiler named 'Perimeter_Boiler' attached to this loop, with a Heat Input Ratio (HIR) of 1.04 (representing ~96% efficiency).
3. In the Air-Side HVAC module, configure the four Top Floor perimeter zones (T.S31, T.E32, T.N33, T.W34) to use 'Hot Water' baseboard heating linked to the 'Perimeter_HW_Loop'.
4. Set the baseboard capacity (BASEBOARD-RATING) for each of these four zones to 15,000 BTU/hr and control type to 'Thermostatic'.
5. Run the annual simulation and save the project.

The building model '4StoreyBuilding' is already loaded. Use Detailed Edit Mode to navigate Water-Side and Air-Side HVAC components.
